  1. 1

    Download

    Download for Mac Download for Windows

    Windows

    Your browser may warn that the file isn't commonly downloaded. In Edge: point at the download, click the … button, then Keep, then Show more → Keep anyway. In Chrome: click Keep.

  2. 2

    Install and open ODd Launcher once

    Mac

    Already have ODd Launcher? Quit it first: click the ODd mark in the menu bar, then Quit.

    Open the downloaded file. Put ODd Launcher in the Applications folder inside your home folder, not the main one, so it can update itself:

    1. In Finder, choose Go → Home.
    2. Open the Applications folder there. If there isn't one, make it: File → New Folder, name it Applications.
    3. Drag ODd Launcher into it, then open it from there.
    4. If macOS asks “Are you sure you want to open it?”, click Open.

    If it's also in the main Applications folder, ask whoever looks after your Mac to remove that copy.

    Windows

    Open the file. If Windows says “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway. The installer needs no administrator and opens the launcher when it's done.

    If Windows says Smart App Control blocked it, there's no way past that message. Don't turn Smart App Control off; tell the person who sent you this link.

    The ODd mark appears in your menu bar (Mac) or by the clock (Windows — look under the ^ arrow if you can't see it).

  3. 3

    Finish setup

    Finish setup

    If your browser asks to open ODd Launcher, allow it. The launcher shows “Team set · ” when it's done.

    Nothing happened? Open ODd Launcher once, then click again. Still nothing? Do steps 1 and 2 again, even if you already have it.
